title: Grateful Dead Live at St. Paul Civic Center on 1983-06-25
source: Sennheisser 421s>Sony TCD5M>cassette>cassette, Recorded by the late George "Fingers" Bethke FOB in the sweet spot as always; first gen. cassettes>Nakamichi CD1, azimuth adjusted>Korg MR1000 (1 bit 5.6MHz) 24/96 with Korg Audiogate; 16/44.1 by Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions). Transfer by Dave Cohen

ai_review.summary: Very good recording with sweet‑spot sound and beloved Uncle John’s Band performance, but limited commentary leaves overall impression mixed.
ai_review.review: Reviewers praise the tape’s sweet‑spot positioning and describe the audio as very good, especially highlighting Uncle John's Band (and a “baby blue” moment). Aside from a brief, non‑descriptive low‑rated comment, there is little detail on the musical flow, leaving the overall sentiment mixed.

ai_rating.rationale: One clear positive review (4★) notes excellent recording quality and favorite songs; a second very brief review rates it 0★, giving mixed signals. Limited detail on performance keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls the tape "very good" and mentions a sweet‑spot sound, but gives no specifics about soundboard vs. audience or mix clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No comments on set structure or pacing were provided.
